summary:
Verified new SEO pre-render feature (backend only). All 11 pytest cases pass across /api/prerender/routes and /api/prerender for /, /solutions, /solutions/business-apps, /brands/roomz, /blog, a dynamic /blog/, plus 404 cases. HTML shells contain route-specific title, meta description, canonical, h1, summary

, og:type, and required JSON-LD schemas (Organization/WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Service+serviceType, Brand, Blog, BlogPosting with headline/author/datePublished).
critical_code_review_comments: seo_prerender.py is well-structured and self-contained (~470 lines, acceptable).
_breadcrumb_schema emits `item: None` for the final crumb when path is empty — currently all callers pass paths, so no impact; consider filtering None to keep JSON-LD clean.
render_seo_html interpolates description into an HTML attribute via html.escape(quote=True) — safe. Good use of json.dumps with ensure_ascii=False and separators.
BLOG_POST_RE requires lowercase slugs; matches server slug generation. Trailing-slash normalization handled.
Endpoint sets Cache-Control public max-age=300 — appropriate for crawlers.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing published blog post from /api/prerender/routes dynamic_routes[0].
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO prerender endpoints fully verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_prerender.py can be reused for regression. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var.
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature verification, no bugs found.
